definition: Reported stored coefficient count: the nominal count (m+1)+k of the recorded pair when that truncation meets the cell target on both the 2,001-node certifying and 4,001-node checking grids under both the 60-digit and binary64 evaluations (mode 'nominal', 40 cells); otherwise the nominal count of a genuine re-solve at the control's count count60 whose truncation meets the target on both grids under binary64 or 60-digit evaluation (mode 'genuine', 1 cell); otherwise the full stored witness len(P)+len(Q)-1 of the recorded pair, whose nominal truncation does not meet the target and for which no genuine re-solve exists at count60 (mode 'full', 4 cells). Each stored coefficient counts once; a cell's pair is the pair that meets.
